title: Interpreting and Steering for Safe and Correct Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30025v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate source code containing vulnerabilities, yet little work studies the internal mechanisms that distinguish safe from vulnerable generation in them. In this work, we systematically perform a mechanistic interpretation of LLMs, aiming at both understanding how code safety-vs-vulnerability is represented or driven by components in an LM and turning the insights into actionable steering strategies to encourage safer code generation. To this end, we introduce CodeSec-Pairs, a dataset of 9,342 Python safe-and-vulnerable contrastive code pairs, sampled from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Utilizing the dataset, we explore approaches to localize layers and attention heads that relate to code safety, and further experiment with different steering strategies for inference-time vulnerability reduction. translated_title: 面向安全且正确代码生成的解释与引导方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.30025v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）经常生成包含漏洞的源代码，然而很少有工作研究模型内部区分安全生成与漏洞生成的机制。在这项工作中，我们对大型语言模型进行了系统的机制解释研究，旨在理解代码的安全性（安全与漏洞）是如何由语言模型的组件所表示或驱动的，并将这些洞察转化为可操作的引导策略，以促进更安全的代码生成。为此，我们引入了CodeSec-Pairs，一个包含9,342个Python安全与漏洞对比代码对的数据集，样本采集自Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。利用该数据集，我们探索了定位与代码安全相关的层和注意力头的方法，并进一步实验了不同的引导策略以在推理阶段减少代码漏洞。特别地，我们提出了DuoSteer，一种双重引导方法，可同时应用安全性与代码正确性……
tldr: 该论文对大型语言模型的代码安全机制进行了系统解释，构建了CodeSec-Pairs安全-漏洞对比数据集，定位了与代码安全相关的层和注意力头，并提出双重引导方法DuoSteer，在推理时同时引导安全性与代码正确性以减少生成代码中的漏洞。
en_tdlr: The paper systematically performs mechanistic interpretation of LLMs for code safety, introduces the CodeSec-Pairs dataset of 9,342 safe-and-vulnerable Python contrastive code pairs, localizes safety-related layers and attention heads, and proposes DuoSteer, a double-steering method that simultaneously steers safety and code correctness at inference time to reduce vulnerabilities in generated code.
